entries.name: GIA_API_URL
entries.description: The Report Results API address GIA gives when the API key is issued. Only https addresses on a gia.edu host are accepted, so the key can't be sent anywhere else.
howToGet: In the GIA Client Portal, apply for Report Results API access under Useful links.
Copy the API address from the signup confirmation.

entries.name: GIA_API_KEY
entries.description: A GIA Report Results API key. It reads reports only. Each plan can have several keys; give KaratOS its own so it can be revoked alone.
howToGet: In the GIA Client Portal, open GET API KEYS and create a key for KaratOS.
Put it straight into the instance's Railway variables. Never send it by chat or email.

entries.name: GIA_REPORT_NUMBERS_FILE
entries.description: A text or CSV file of the GIA report numbers to look up, one per line in the first column, such as the certificate numbers on the business's stones. Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Export the certificate number column for GIA-graded stones from the POS or inventory system.
Save it outside any git repo and put its path here. Add new numbers to the end; each is looked up once.

entries.name: GIA_MAX_LOOKUPS_PER_SYNC
entries.description: The most new report numbers one sync looks up. Lookups of reports the business didn't submit cost money on a pay-as-you-go plan, so this caps what one sync can spend. Defaults to 100.
howToGet: Raise it for the first import of a large inventory, after checking the plan's remaining lookups.
